termination_reason: Monolithic Newton-Raphson tangent non-convexity during localized crack advance
scientific_conclusion: Finer coarse discretization (h=0.60 mm = 2.11*l0) resolved damage initiation over 2-3 element layers, expanding converged equilibrium increments from 64 to 170 (2.66x) and advancing damage to d_max = 0.9318 (with 45 elements d > 0.10) compared to F1688's d_max = 0.7722 at increment 64. Terminal dissipated fracture energy reached 13.43 mJ (0.01343 J) at u_y = 0.0687 mm in F1690 compared to 16.09 mJ (0.01609 J) at u_y = 0.0810 mm in F1688 (ratio 0.834), reflecting earlier initiation on the sharper refined notch. At increment 171, monolithic coupled UEL tangent non-convexity caused cutback limit exhaustion (dt < 1e-7 s, Exit Code 1). Monolithic Newton solvers cannot traverse crack propagation on macroscopic geometry without either a staggered operator split or a localized adapted mesh.
